newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan June overdue loan ratio rises to 3.82 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan June overdue loan ratio rises to 3.82 pct.

text.p: Taiwan banks' overdue loans accounted for 3.82 percent of their total loans at the end of June, up from 3.62 percent at the end of March and 3.10 percent at the end of December 1995, the central bank said on Monday.
Of the financial institutions, domestic banks' overdue loans accounted for 3.47 percent of their total loans, compared with foreign banks' 1.08 percent and credit unions' 5.01 percent.
The central bank, which announces the figures on a quarterly basis, did not give the total value of overdue loans and other details.
It has attributed the high percentage of overdue loans to a slowing local economy, which is making local enterprises' operating environment more difficult.
